title: The Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis via elementary expansions
summary: We prove the Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis for every Grothendieck coherator in the Ara–Henry convention: its weak globular infinity-groupoids recover the homotopy theory of spaces. We also resolve Henry's pushout conjecture, showing that elementary expansions preserve components and all homotopy groups of cellular infinity-groupoids.

review.reason: Proves the Grothendieck homotopy hypothesis for a class of coherators and resolves a pushout conjecture.
